name: Laxmipati Engineering Works Ltd
about: Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited (Formerly known as L. P. Naval & Engineering Limited) is engaged in the Business of Fabrication, Heavy Engineering, Engineering Infrastructure and services and Shut down maintenance projects. The company was incorporated in 2012 as a Ship Building company and has build itself as a reliable partner Manufacturing, Engineering Services, Repair and Upgrade.[1]
keyPoints:
Business[1]
Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited generates its major revenue by providing manpower and fabricating service to Engineering sector.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 30.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 17.6 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 59.2 to 72.6 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
